name: Spider-Man Pointing at Spider-Man
look: A still from the 1960s Spider-Man cartoon. Two identical Spider-Men in red and blue suits face each other and point accusingly. The left one stands in front of a white van marked NYPD, the right one beside stacked wooden crates and a red wall.
use: Two people or things that are really the same accuse or recognize each other. Each Spider-Man gets a label, usually exposing hypocrisy or a funny resemblance between two sides.
examples: Me telling my friend to go to bed at 3 am
My friend telling me to go to bed at 3 am

spider man points at another spider man who points back
identical superheroes accusing each other by a police van

origin: From 'Double Identity', an episode of the 1967 Spider-Man animated series, where an impostor in a Spider-Man suit meets the real one.
